queries:
WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT
    corpeventprx,
    AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
    AVG(CASE
      WHEN inholdpct IS NOT NULL AND instownpct IS NOT NULL
      THEN inholdpct - instownpct
    END) AS avg_gap
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
)
SELECT
  corpeventprx,
  avg_anlycount,
  avg_gap - (SELECT AVG(avg_gap) FROM group_averages) AS centered_avg_gap
FROM group_averages

WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT
        corpeventprx,
        AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN inholdpct IS NOT NULL AND instownpct IS NOT NULL
            THEN inholdpct - instownpct
        END) AS avg_gap
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
    GROUP BY corpeventprx
)
SELECT
    corpeventprx,
    avg_anlycount,
    avg_gap - (
        SELECT AVG(avg_gap)
        FROM event_averages
        WHERE corpeventprx IS NOT NULL
    ) AS adjusted_avg_gap
FROM event_averages

WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT
    corpeventprx,
    AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
    AVG(inholdpct) - AVG(instownpct) AS ownership_difference
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
)
SELECT
  corpeventprx,
  avg_anlycount,
  ownership_difference - AVG(ownership_difference) OVER () AS adjusted_difference
FROM group_averages

WITH event_averages AS (
  SELECT
    corpeventprx,

)
SELECT
  corpeventprx,

  ownership_difference - (
    SELECT AVG(ownership_difference)
    FROM event_averages
    WHERE corpeventprx IS NOT NULL
  ) AS adjusted_ownership_difference
FROM event_averages

WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT
        corpeventprx,
        AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
        AVG(instownpct - inholdpct) AS avg_gap
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
    GROUP BY corpeventprx
)
SELECT
    corpeventprx,
    avg_anlycount,
    avg_gap - (SELECT AVG(avg_gap) FROM group_averages) AS centered_avg_gap
FROM group_averages

WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT
        corpeventprx,
        AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN instownpct IS NOT NULL AND inholdpct IS NOT NULL
            THEN instownpct - inholdpct
        END) AS avg_ownership_gap
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
    GROUP BY corpeventprx
)
SELECT
    corpeventprx,
    avg_anlycount,
    avg_ownership_gap - (
        SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_gap)
        FROM event_averages
        WHERE corpeventprx IS NOT NULL
    ) AS adjusted_ownership_gap
FROM event_averages
